items: Building: AI × Hardware products (Interactive / Sensors / NFC)

items.title: PingCAP - Database Unicorn
items.description: Joined the core tool TiCDC team for R&D. Later transitioned to community operations, participating in the renaissance of China's open source ecosystem. Began understanding the power of developer relations and open source communities.

items.title: Actionsky - AI Infra
items.description: Led the company's AI Infra vector database business. Before vector databases were recognized by the market, our team explored 'AI + data infrastructure', becoming one of the first teams in China to build AI-Native SaaS products in early 2023.

items.title: From Tech to Business
items.description: Led commercialization at a HK company, then headed the AI middle platform at SJTU Research Institute. Completed the capability leap from technologist to entrepreneur: Tech → Business → Organization & Product delivery.

items.title: AGI Villa - AI Builder Accelerator
items.description: Co-founding AGI Villa, helping Builders ship AI + Hardware products from 0 to 1. Building global community-driven execution and growth mechanisms.
